notes.title: Suit Up - Update 4.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Pilots!

Suit Up - Update 4.0 is here! This monumental update marks our official departure from Early Access and represents the culmination of our incredible journey together. After years of development, community feedback, and countless iterations, Suit Up is now a complete, polished experience ready for the world.

It's been an exciting journey and challenge getting to this stage. The lessons learned from developing Suit Up have been invaluable and I'll be taking all I've learned onto the next project!

Now, let's celebrate what makes Update 4.0 so special!

🎯 Official Launch - Out of Early Access! After extensive development and your incredible feedback, Suit Up is now a complete game! This milestone represents not just feature completion, but the realization of our shared vision for the ultimate mech combat experience.

🔧 Revolutionary Circuit Board Chip Upgrade System The long-awaited strategic upgrade system has finally arrived:

Chip Synergies - Discover powerful combinations when certain chips are connected

Chip Management - Slots are shared for certain powers so prioritize your upgrades!

Build Variety - Countless combinations ensure no two mechs play exactly alike

🔫 Arsenal Expansion New Close range weapons join the fight with devastating results:

Chainsaw - Rip apart enemies at close range! Finally take the fight to them!

Shield - Creates an impenetrable barrier protecting from all attacks! 

🌍 New Battlegrounds Fresh environments await your exploration:

Map variations - Each area has 2 new map variants!

✨ Polish & Refinement Every system has been refined to perfection:

Enhanced UI/UX - Streamlined menus and improved information presentation

Audio Overhaul - Crisp weapon sounds, atmospheric music, and immersive environmental audio

Visual Polish - Updated textures, improved lighting, and enhanced particle effects

🎮 Gameplay Enhancements

Difficulty Scaling - Dynamic challenge adjustment ensures engaging combat for all skill levels

Control Refinements - Tighter mech handling and more responsive combat

🐞 Final Bug Elimination Our most comprehensive bug fixing pass ever:

Litany of small bugs and fixes

Eliminated save data corruption issues

Addressed community-reported edge cases

🚀 Looking Forward While this marks the end of Suit Up's development journey, it's just the beginning of what's possible. The foundation we've built together - the lessons about mech combat, progression design, and community engagement - will fuel even more ambitious projects ahead.

I'm incredibly excited to take everything we've learned and push the boundaries even further in my next game. Stay tuned for announcements!

💌 Final Thank You To every pilot who joined this journey: THANK YOU! 🫡

Your feedback shaped every system. Your passion drove every improvement. Your support made this dream a reality. Suit Up exists in its final form because of YOU.

From Early Access to full release, you've been the best community a developer could ask for. As we close this chapter and begin the next, know that your impact will be felt in everything I create going forward.

The mech bay doors are now permanently open. Your mission awaits.

Join our Discord: Discord

Happy hunting, Pilots - and thank you for making Suit Up legendary!

notes.title: Suit Up - Update 3.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Pilots!

Suit Up - Update 3.0 is here! This massive update represents another major step forward as we continue our journey toward the final 4.0 release that will bring Suit Up out of Early Access.
Before diving into the details, I want to share some important news about Suit Up's future. After months of dedicated development, I'm actively seeking publishing partners to help bring this game to a wider audience. I've already reached out to publishers like Humble Bundle and Team17, and I'm optimistic about finding the right partner to help Suit Up reach its full potential.
With my first child due in just a couple of months, I'm working hard to get Suit Up to a satisfactory level of completion before then. The upcoming 4.0 update will be our final major release, featuring the long-awaited mech upgrade circuit board system that will add a whole new layer of strategic depth to your upgrade choices!
Now, let's explore what's new in Update 3.0!

💥 VFX Overhaul
This visual overhaul has dramatically improved all our explosions and brought in exciting new effects:


 Enhanced missile effects with more spectacular visuals
 Improved explosive barrel destruction
 Better grenade detonations
 Enhanced screen shake for more impactful combat
 Improved damage flash effects
 Upgraded drone ability effects



🌍 Level Improvements
Responding to community feedback, we've reworked environments and lighting:


 Improved lighting with dynamic angles so environments feel more three-dimensional
 More variations of day and night lighting scenarios
 New levels added to Plains & Desert Biomes with level tweaks throughout
 Experimental Level Rotator - Levels now rotate to provide much more variety!
 Updated survival level endings for better flow



🔫 Weapon Balancing

Shotgun Rebalance - The shotgun was overpowered in an unfun way, so damage is now properly distributed between fragments rather than dealing full damage from each


🤖 New Drone System Overhaul
We've completely rebuilt the Drone System with exciting new features and abilities:

 New Drone Abilities: Destroy crawlers with Napalm, Mines, and Nukes!
 Shop Integration: All drone abilities can now be purchased and equipped from your Base Shop
 Expanded Loadouts: Unlock more slots and equip up to 5 drone abilities for battle
 Charge System: All abilities now use charges - each charge makes the ability more powerful!



🎯 Fun Additions


 Hidden Cheat Menu - There's now a secret cheat menu hidden in the game. Good luck figuring it out! 😉
 Enhanced Easter Egg - Added more hints to the Base Area easter egg since nobody's solved it yet!
 New Dialogue - Fresh conversations with Holobug to discover



🔧 Miscellaneous Improvements


 Cleaned up collision layers so objects react more naturally to explosions and environmental effects
 Improved shot reflection mechanics when deflecting spitter attacks with the Pulse weapon
 Pulse-reflected shots now properly damage crawlers
 Better enemy balancing and more dynamic horde sizes
 Upload level improvements - Crawlers no longer always target the upload spot
 Enhanced mech running audio
 Optimized save data processing and reduced saving times
 Removed the "Leaving Area" killzone and warning system



🐞 Bug Fixes
We've squashed numerous bugs reported by the community:

 Fixed Log sequencer visibility issues behind environmental objects
 Resolved void grenade mod malfunction
 Fixed infinite fuel exploit
 Corrected Backyard area menu not opening properly
 Resolved multiple audio firing issues
 Fixed Double Barreled mod functionality
 Repaired Controls menu button
 Prevented repair kits from falling through floor
 Corrected Fracture Cryo mod visual effects
 Fixed several Log menu opening errors
 Resolved spore attack damage spam
 Fixed enemy scaling calculation bugs



🔮 Looking Ahead to Update 4.0
The final major update is already in development and will feature:

Mech Upgrade Circuit Board System - A completely new strategic layer for your upgrade chips and equipment choices
Final polish and completion features to bring Suit Up out of Early Access


💌 Community Appreciation
To all our dedicated pilots: Thank you! 🫡 Your support and feedback have been incredible throughout this journey. I couldn't have asked for more committed supporters as we work toward making Suit Up the best it can be.
Your continued engagement helps shape every update, and I hope these improvements and the upcoming final release will help support my growing family while delivering the mech combat experience you deserve.
Join our Discord: Discord

Thank you for your continued support!
Happy hunting, Pilots!

notes.title: Suit Up - Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Pilots!

Suit Up - Update 2.0 is here! Building on our first major update, we've continued listening to your feedback and have implemented numerous improvements and fixes to enhance your experience battling through crawler-infested landscapes.

Before diving into the details, we have some exciting news - a free playable demo of Suit Up is now available! We really want to build our community and hear from our players in these early stages so this is perfect for players who want to try before they buy, or for anyone curious about joining the fight against the crawler menace!

Now, let's explore what's new in Update 2.0!

---

🎮 Control & Combat Improvements

We've continued refining the mech handling and combat experience:

- Slow-mo effects are smoother and more fluid
- Enhanced missile launcher - Now displays impact area when firing, and missiles dramatically launch from the back of your mech
- You can now move your mech while inputting drone commands
- A timer for how long the drone input window is open, so you can't play in slow motion for ever!
- Added auto-aim for all weapons

---

🔧 Weapons Upgrade System Overhaul

We've completely revamped the weapons progression system, these changes ensure each upgrade feels genuinely impactful and worth the investment:

- All weapons now have 10 upgrade levels
-  Each upgrade level provides increasingly powerful improvements
- Upgrade pricing now follows a more affordable and fair curve

---

## 🎯 Visual Enhancements

We're constantly working to make Suit Up look and feel better:

- Updated enemy death splatter effects with more visceral and satisfying crawler destruction
- Portals now display the specific upgrade chip you'll earn in the next level
- New menus systems for the Story and Data Logs

---

## 📖 Story Expansion

We've added substantial story content to enrich the world of Suit Up:

- Story Implementation - Discover the narrative behind the crawler infestation and your mission
- Collect data logs and the uncover secrets and lore scattered throughout the game world

---
## 🐞 Bugs

We've fixed some bugs as well:
- Minigun Fire Rate - The minigun now performs consistently at its intended fire rate
- Plasma charge vfx now properly aligned with weapon barrel.

---

## 🔮 Future Plans

We're not stopping here! Our roadmap includes:
- New mech variants with unique handling characteristics
- Additional weapon types and customization options
- More challenging crawler variants and boss encounters

---

## 💌 Community Feedback

Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping Suit Up into the game it is today. Please continue sharing your thoughts and experiences with us!

Join our Discord: [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/8pXSvrg9sg)

---

Thank you for your continued support!

Happy hunting, Pilots!

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes:
⚡ Update 1.0 ⚡

Hi guys! It's been a good first month and I'm very happy for all the support received!
As a solo dev I feel the weight and pressure of all of this but also the enjoyment and pride in creating all this myself.
The feedback and this update have reinspired me and given me a fresh breath of motivation. 
I hope you all enjoy!

🎮 Control Improvements
Increased mech rotation and speed for smoother gameplay
Reduced pulse cooldown for more tactical options
Improved on ice mechanics with more realistic sliding.

👾 New Enemies
The self-destructing bomb crawler! Powerful kamikaze enemies that will keep you on your toes! 
The spore master crawler! Empowers other crawlers with spores that heal and grant them increased powers!
Improved enemy AI making movement more optimized and smoother.

💰 Economizing
Weapon upgrades are more affordable, making it easier to power up!
Run rewards based purely on difficulty, not completion. So quitting or unexpected exits wont lose your rewards. 
Weapon upgrades have a more noticeable impact, so you feel your upgrades from one run to the next.

🔧 Balance Tweaks
Upgrade Chips offer more positive effects with fewer downsides, making the option even more powerful!
Greater variety of upgrade options available, with new stats boosts, upgrade chips and weapon mods!

🌍 Environment Updates
Six new levels! Two each for our first 3 biomes! Plains, Desert and Tundra!  
Areas have more unique feel with area-specific crawler types, getting gradually harder as you progress. 
General cleanup and polish throughout game environments and updating old assets.

notes.title: ⚡ SUIT UP - WHATS PLANNED FOR UPDATE 1.0 ⚡
notes.notes:
Greetings, Pilots! 

We're thrilled to announce our first major update for Suit Up is launching by the end of this month! We've been listening closely to your feedback since our initial release, and we're excited to introduce a range of improvements that will enhance your experience battling through the crawler-infested landscapes.

But first an apology, our discord link was broken so we know we have probably missed many of you who tried to join for which we are very sorry! Please join us now with this link, all other links have been fixed as well. 

Discord

With that out the way, let's dive into what's coming!

---

🎮 Control Improvements

One of the main feedbacks we had was mech movement so we have:

- Increased mech rotation speed - Your mech will now respond more quickly to directional changes, allowing for faster target acquisition and smoother gameplay overall.
- Increased mech dodge distance.
- Reduced pulse cooldown.

---

👾 New Enemy Types

Two new crawler variants are joining the fray, each with unique behaviours that will require fresh tactics:

Bomb Crawler
- Self-destructing enemy that rushes toward your mech when detected
- Creates a medium-radius explosion on death

Spore Master
- Specialized support crawler that enhances nearby crawler units
- Emits spores that increase other crawlers' movement speed and attack rate
- Spore clouds also damage your mech!

---

💰 Economy Rebalance

We've revamped the game's economy to make progression more rewarding and less grindy:

- Weapon upgrade costs reduced across all weapons, making improvements more accessible.
- Run rewards now calculated purely based on difficulty level rather than completion status. This way you're always rewarded for your effort even if a run doesn't end in success.
- Weapon upgrades improvements:
 - More Levels available
 - Stats increases are balanced across the levels

These changes ensure that you'll feel a meaningful progression with each upgrade you purchase.

---

 🔧 Balance Tweaks

We've revisited the Upgrade Chip system to make tough choices more interesting and less punishing:

- Upgrade Chips now offer more substantial positive effects while featuring less severe drawbacks
- Expanded the variety of available upgrades

---

🌍 Environment Updates

We've enhanced environmental variety and polished existing areas:

- Each zone now features area-specific crawler variants with unique behaviours and visual designs
- Large Update to the Plains Biome with new areas and assets.
- Optimized level generation for better scene management.
- General clean-up and polish throughout all game environments, fixing various visual glitches and improving performance

---

📅 Future Plans

While we're excited about what Update 1.0 brings to Mech Crawler, we're already planning future enhancements, including:

- New mech variants with unique handling characteristics and weapon loadouts
- More story elements to uncover the mysteries of the crawler infestation!

---

💌 Community Feedback

Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update, and we want to continue this collaborative approach to development. Let us know what you think of these changes and what you'd like to see in future updates!

Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8pXSvrg9sg

---

Thank you for your continued support! The update will be available by the end of this month.

Happy hunting, Pilots!

notes.title: Hotfix - 01
notes.notes:
We are nothing if not quick on some minor bugs that had effected some of our players on release.
This includes:
- Bug: Freezing in the tutorial when cancelling skip menu.
- Bug: Collision issues in the plains river area.
- Bug: Settings menu not applying settings in the starting lobby.
- Bug: Credits menu loading starting lobby from main menu.

It always happens and things slip through the cracks, but we will remain vigilant and continue to listen to our players feedback.
Thank you!
